examples.sentence: 他这么多天没来上课，最可能的原因就是他回国了。
examples.romanization: tā zhème duō tiān méi lái shàngkè， zuì kěnéng de yuányīn jiùshì tā huíguó le。
examples.translation: He did not come to class for so many days. The most probable reason is that he returned to China.

examples.sentence: 等你身体出现问题了，后悔就来不及了。
examples.romanization: děng nǐ shēntǐ chūxiàn wèntí le， hòuhuǐ jiù láibují le。
examples.translation: When you have a problem with your health, it’ll be too late to regret it.

title: V + V + O (VO for a bit (reduplication))
longExplanation: VO for a bit (reduplication). Pinyin: V + V + O

examples.sentence: 咱们午饭后就去附近的公园散散步吧。
examples.romanization: zánmen wǔfàn hòu jiù qù fùjìn de gōngyuán sànsànbù ba。
examples.translation: Let's go for a walk in the nearby park after lunch.

title: V + 了 + V + O (V’ed O for a bit (reduplication))
longExplanation: V’ed O for a bit (reduplication). Pinyin: V + le + V + O

examples.sentence: 星期天我睡了睡觉，游了游泳，做了做作业。
examples.romanization: Xīngqītiān wǒ shuì le shuìjiào， yóu le yóuyǒng， zuò le zuò zuòyè。
examples.translation: On Sunday, I slept a bit, did some swimming, [and] did some homework.

examples.sentence: 要是质量好的话，那么价格贵一点儿也没关系。
examples.romanization: yàoshi zhìliàng hǎo dehuà， nàme jiàgé guì yīdiǎnr yě méiguānxi。
examples.translation: If the quality is good, then it doesn't matter if the price is a little bit expensive.

title: 既..... 又/也/还…… (not only… but also…)
longExplanation: not only… but also…. Pinyin: jì..... yòu/ yě/ hái……

examples.sentence: 散步既可以活动身体，又可以减肥。
examples.romanization: sànbù jì kěyǐ huódòng shēntǐ， yòu kěyǐ jiǎnféi。
examples.translation: Walking can [allow you to] both move the body and lose weight.

title: 使 O A/V (make O A/V)
longExplanation: make O A/V. Pinyin: shǐ O A/V

examples.sentence: 怎么样才能使她喜欢我呢？
examples.romanization: zěnmeyàng cáinéng shǐ tā xǐhuan wǒ ne？
examples.translation: How can I make her like me?

title: 只要……(就)…… (as long as… (then)…)
longExplanation: as long as… (then)…. Pinyin: zhǐyào……( jiù)……

examples.sentence: 只要这次你好好儿准备，(就) 一定能把比赛踢好。
examples.romanization: zhǐyào zhè cì nǐhǎo hǎo r zhǔnbèi，( jiù) yīdìng néng bǎ bǐsài tī hǎo。
examples.translation: As long as you are ready this time, you will be able to play the match well.

examples.sentence: A: 没想到咱们毕业都已经十年了。B: 可不是！时间过得太快了， 真想大家。
examples.romanization: A: méixiǎngdào zánmen bìyè dōu yǐjīng shí nián le。B: kěbushì！ shíjiān guòdé tài kuài le， zhēn xiǎng dàjiā。
examples.translation: A: I didn't expect that we have graduated for ten years.

examples.sentence: 我认识他很多年，因此，很了解他的性格。
examples.romanization: wǒ rènshi tā hěn duō nián， yīncǐ， hěn liǎojiě tā de xìnggé。
examples.translation: I have known him for many years, so I know his character very well.

examples.sentence: 女孩子对衣服颜色的选择往往与她们的性格有关。
examples.romanization: nǚháizi duì yīfu yánsè de xuǎnzé wǎngwǎng yǔ tāmen de xìnggé yǒuguān。
examples.translation: Girls' choice of clothing color is often related to their personality.

examples.sentence: 上大学时我很喜欢运动，经常/常打篮球、踢足球。
examples.romanization: shàng dàxué shí wǒ hěn xǐhuan yùndòng， jīngcháng/ cháng dǎ lánqiú、 tī zúqiú。
examples.translation: When I was in college, I liked sports very much. I often played basketball and football.

title: 难道 (could it be that)
longExplanation: could it be that. Pinyin: nándào

examples.sentence: 怎么又买了这么多饼干和巧克力？难道你不减肥了？
examples.romanization: zěnme yòu mǎi le zhème duō bǐnggān hé qiǎokèlì？ nándào nǐ bù jiǎnféi le？
examples.translation: How did you buy so many cookies and chocolates? Could it be that you’re not dieting any more?

examples.sentence: 任何成功都要通过努力才能得到。
examples.romanization: rènhé chénggōng dōu yào tōngguò nǔlì cáinéng dédào。
examples.translation: Any success must be achieved through hard work.

title: 经过 (after having gone through)
longExplanation: after having gone through. Pinyin: jīngguò

examples.sentence: 经过一次次失败之后，他终于成功了。
examples.romanization: jīngguò yīcì cì shībài zhīhòu， tā zhōngyú chénggōng le。
examples.translation: Having gone through many failures, he finally succeeded.
